scripts.sync-engine:
rm -rf public/engine && mkdir -p public/engine && cp -R ../../dist/npm-mctick/. public/engine/ && node -e "const f='public/engine/TickSimulation.mjs',s=require('fs').readFileSync(f,'utf8');if(!s.includes('machineGraphJson')){console.error('
  engine lacks machineGraphJson — package-npm.sh defaults to bridge,simulation,meshing and OMITS mc-tick.
  rebuild: NUCLEATION_WASM_FEATURES=bridge,simulation,meshing,mc-tick ./tools/package-npm.sh dist/npm-mctick
');process.exit(1)}"
scripts.engine: cd ../.. && ./tools/package-npm.sh dist/npm-simlab && cp dist/npm-simlab/*.mjs dist/npm-simlab/*.wasm dist/npm-simlab/*.d.mts apps/sim-lab-wasm/public/engine/ && echo 'engine refreshed — now: npm run build'
